items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: David Baker conducted. David arranged Treblinka, that Richie wrote, his tune for the concentration camp.

ctx.x: Here’s an interesting one called Dedications, with a string quartet.

That’s the post-Chick, learning about string quartets. When I came out of Chick, after playing those three months with the string quartet, I thought, whoa, wait a minute. I got Ravel, Debussy, Beethoven’s last three, and Bartok 6, I put a year into studying, and I took the nerve to write string quartets. David Baker conducted. David arranged Treblinka, that Richie wrote, his tune for the concentration camp. I wrote a tune for my wife at the time, The Delicacy of Youth, and I wrote a tune for Richie, The Code’s…
